Musical artist

**Burhan Genç Koç** (Danish:[[ˈpuɐ̯hɑn ke̝ˀntɕ ˈkʰɔˀtɕ]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:IPA/Danish "Help:IPA/Danish"); born 20 January 1983), known as **Burhan G** (Danish:[[ˈpuɐ̯hɑn ˈke̝ˀ]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:IPA/Danish "Help:IPA/Danish")),[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burhan_G#cite_note-1) is a Danish [R&B](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Contemporary_R&B "Contemporary R&B") and pop singer, songwriter and producer. He has released three albums including _[Burhan G](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burhan\_G\_(album) "Burhan G (album)")_ in 2010 and _[Din for evigt](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Din\_for\_evigt "Din for evigt")_, both certified platinum in Denmark. Hit singles include the five number one hits "[Mest ondt](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mest_ondt "Mest ondt")" featuring [Medina](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Medina_(singer) "Medina (singer)"), "[Tættere på himlen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/T%C3%A6ttere_p%C3%A5_himlen "Tættere på himlen")" featuring [Nik & Jay](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nik_&_Jay "Nik & Jay"), "Din for evigt", "Kalder mig hjem" and "Karma" featuring [L.O.C.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/L.O.C._(rapper) "L.O.C. (rapper)")

## Early life and career

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Burhan_G&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Early life and career")]

Burhan Genç is of [Kurdish](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kurds "Kurds") origin.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burhan_G#cite_note-auto-2) His parents are from [Haymana](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Haymana "Haymana"), Turkey. He lived in [Brøndby Strand](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Br%C3%B8ndby_Strand "Brøndby Strand") ([Copenhagen County](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copenhagen_County "Copenhagen County")) 13 kilometers south-west of central [Copenhagen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copenhagen "Copenhagen") and sang in the "Københavns Drengekor" (Copenhagen Boys Choir) as a solo soprano. He was also a backing singer for the popular Danish hip hop group [Outlandish](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Outlandish "Outlandish"). The group originated from [Brøndby Strand](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Br%C3%B8ndby_Strand "Brøndby Strand") projects and Burhan G toured with the group as backing vocals and also delivered the chorus in the Outlandish hit "Walou" from their debut album _[Outland's Official](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Outland's\_Official "Outland's Official")_. Collaborations followed with various other acts including [Funk Flush](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Funk_Flush?action=edit&redlink=1 "Funk Flush (page does not exist)"), Cas and [U$O](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/U$O "U$O").

## Career

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Burhan_G&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Career")]

Burhan G's solo debut was with the signature track "Burhan G", which was on [P3 Radio](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DR_P3 "DR P3")'s _Uundgåelige_ in September 2003. On 24 May 2004, Burhan G released his debut album _Playground_ on BMG, with a further track featured on Danish Radio P3's _Uundgåelige_ with single "Take U Home". The album _Playground_ got Burhan G nominated in 2005 to 3 categories in the Danish Music Awards. He won the award for Best Danish Newcomer. He was nominated for Danish P3 Radio's "P3 Prisen" and "P3 Gennembrudet" at P3 Guld ceremonies. That same year he won the award for "Best Danish Album" at the Danish DeeJay Awards.

In March 2007, Burhan G signed with record label [Copenhagen Records](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copenhagen_Records "Copenhagen Records")[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burhan_G#cite_note-3) instead of BMG and on 10 September 2007 released with them his second album _Breakout_ and a single from the album cowritten by Burhan G and Frederik Tao from Maximum Risk and entitled "Who Is He" became a hit.

In the summer of 2008, Burhan G released his new single "Kun dig" ("Only you"). It was written in collaboration with Claus Seest and produced by [Majid](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Majid_(rapper) "Majid (rapper)") and Saqib.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burhan_G#cite_note-4) The song was Burhan G's first hit in Danish followed by a Danish-language album, the self-titled _Burhan G_. This was followed by another successful single written in collaboration with [Rasmus Seebach](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rasmus_Seebach "Rasmus Seebach") in Danish entitled "Jeg vil ha' dig for mig selv" ("I want you for myself") that heavily sampled [Milli Vanilli](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Milli_Vanilli "Milli Vanilli")'s 1988 hit "[Girl You Know It's True](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Girl_You_Know_It's_True_(song) "Girl You Know It's True (song)")". Parts of the lyrics came from [Nik & Jay](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nik_&_Jay "Nik & Jay")'s song "I Love Ya" and in November 2009, that version was released by Nik & Jay providing vocals.

In April 2010, Burhan G collaborated with Rasmus Seebach again alongside Sarah West and Nik & Jay.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burhan_G#cite_note-5) He explained in a press release that he chose to express himself in Danish, "because I love music and because I love all the different ways one can express oneself" claiming he was inspired by artists [Kim Carnes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kim_Carnes "Kim Carnes") and [Sanne Salomonsen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sanne_Salomonsen "Sanne Salomonsen") and [Kim Larsen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kim_Larsen "Kim Larsen"). This Danish venture proved quite well as it gave Burhan G his first ever Danish No. 1 in "[Mest ondt](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mest_ondt "Mest ondt")" (translated as What hurts the most) released on 8 March 2010 and reaching the [Tracklisten](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tracklisten "Tracklisten") (Danish Singles Chart) top spot for 1 week. The single features the Danish singer [Medina](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Medina_(singer) "Medina (singer)"). The follow-up single "[Tættere på himlen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/T%C3%A6ttere_p%C3%A5_himlen "Tættere på himlen")" featuring [Nik & Jay](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nik_&_Jay "Nik & Jay") also topped the charts for three weeks in October 2010. Both were certified platinum in addition to a preceding single "Jeg vil ha' dig for mig selv" also certified platinum. "Who Is He" and "Kun dig" singles have been certified gold in Denmark.

## Collaborations

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Burhan_G&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Collaborations")]

[![Image 5](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/40/Burhan_G_20110515.jpg/250px-Burhan_G_20110515.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Burhan_G_20110515.jpg)

Burhan G has collaborated with a great number of artists:

*   He collaborated early on with various other acts including [Funk Flush](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Funk_Flush?action=edit&redlink=1 "Funk Flush (page does not exist)") and A-Double-B
*   He appeared in U$O song "I går var det en vild nat" (translated as Yesterday was a wild night)
*   He also sang in the soundtrack song entitled "Live Ur Life" on director [Hella Joof](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hella_Joof "Hella Joof")'s film [Fidibus](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fidibus "Fidibus").
*   He had guest appearances with many artists including [Majid](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Majid_(rapper) "Majid (rapper)"), Kisa and [Karina Kappel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Karina_Kappel?action=edit&redlink=1 "Karina Kappel (page does not exist)").
*   Burhan co-wrote and contributed in the vocals of "Let Me Think About It" in [Ida Corr](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ida_Corr "Ida Corr")'s album _Robosoul_ in 2006.
*   In September 2007 he appeared in Dutch House DJ [Fedde le Grand](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedde_le_Grand "Fedde le Grand") remixed album that was a huge international hit for Fedde le Grand, including Europe and the United States.
*   In June 2009, Burhan also appeared in an international hit by House DJ [Dominik de Leon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dominik_de_Leon?action=edit&redlink=1 "Dominik de Leon (page does not exist)") entitled "Everything Changes" and credits Dominik de Leon vs. Burhan G.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burhan_G#cite_note-6)
*   Burhan G has written "Tag med mig" (translated Come with me) for [Basim](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Basim_(singer) "Basim (singer)"), in the latter's album _Alt det jeg ville have sagt_ (translated Everything I would have said).
*   He also worked with American DJ [Roger Sanchez](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roger_Sanchez "Roger Sanchez") in "Bang That Box".
*   He co-wrote and produced the song "Domino Effect" to the English dancepop duo [Addictive](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Addictive_(British_band) "Addictive (British band)") released in October 2009.
*   His hit "[Mest ondt](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mest_ondt "Mest ondt")" features the Danish singer [Medina](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Medina_(singer) "Medina (singer)").
*   The follow-up single "[Tættere på himlen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/T%C3%A6ttere_p%C3%A5_himlen "Tættere på himlen")" features [Nik & Jay](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nik_&_Jay "Nik & Jay").
